reviews.review_msg: Dr. Gajdamaschko is an intellectually generous and exceptional professor. Her courses combine intellectual rigor with a respectful environment where students can question assumptions and develop original ideas. Her perceptive feedback helps students find their scholarly voice and connect theory meaningfully to educational practice.

This prof is completely out of touch with her students.  The workload she demanded(2 group projects with power point presentations and essays, long final paper, and 10 pages of double entry journals)was insane.  No one in the class could keep up with the readings. Did she want us to take up time presenting so she wouldn't have to teach? GET REAL!!!
